# Docker CLI observation fixtures

`048-created.inspect.json` is a sanitized narrow projection of actual Docker Engine/CLI **29.8.1** `docker inspect --type container -- <exact-owned-id>` output, captured 2026-09-29 on Linux x86_64. The first local capture was independently repeated through native OpenSSH 10.2p1 and an owned loopback sshd with strict trust and a forced allowlist. Remote inspect JSON equaled the independent local Docker CLI JSON; the normalized projection matched this fixture exactly. This is remote CLI evidence, not a native GUI test.

Both captures removed inherited `DOCKER_*` environment overrides and used `docker --config <owned-empty-directory> --host unix:///var/run/docker.sock`. The only target was a newly created, **never started** disposable container from `alpine@sha256:14358309a308569c32bdc37e2e0e9694be33a9d99e68afb0f5ff33cc1f695dce`, network `none`, read-only root, all capabilities dropped, exposed `8080/tcp`, explicit lab ownership label, and synthetic `TOKEN`/label values. The test removed only the exact stopped ID with `docker rm -- <id>`, reaped its owned sshd and removed generated temporary keys/config. It never used a user SSH alias, user identities or a production host.

Reproduction uses the same disposable recipe and remote command:

```text
docker create --name <owned-unique-name> --label dev.containerdesk.lab=048 \
  --label token=SEEDED_048_LABEL --env TOKEN=SEEDED_048_ENV --expose 8080/tcp \
  --network none --read-only --cap-drop ALL <pinned-image> /bin/true
ssh -T -n -F <owned-config> -o BatchMode=yes -- capture-owned \
  "exec '/usr/bin/docker' 'inspect' '--type' 'container' '--' '<exact-owned-id>'"
```

`capture-owned` is created explicitly in the temporary config; fingerprints come from the generated owned server key and strict checking remains enabled. `tests/lab/logs_gate.py` admitted only the single owned inspect ID. The source trust file hash was unchanged after execution. These setup commands are not part of ordinary unit tests.

Projection/normalization: retained top-level Id/Name/Image/Created/RestartCount/Config/State/HostConfig/Mounts/NetworkSettings; retained only fields consumed by inspect or relevant nearby unknown fields. Replaced container/image IDs, container name, creation timestamp and image reference with fixed documented values. Network/endpoint identity strings were normalized to empty (already empty for this created `none` endpoint). No optional field was converted between null, absent and zero. Environment and label values are intentional synthetic sentinels, not credentials.

Observed semantics: state `created`; zero-sentinel StartedAt/FinishedAt; **absent** healthcheck/health; **null** PidsLimit and network Aliases; zero memory/CPU values; no mounts/published bindings; exposed port configuration present. Rust must preserve the distinctions: no invented start/finish time or health, no invented PID limit, and no published port inferred from exposure. The fixture passes through the production Rust parser into Rust-serde-generated `tests/fixtures/ipc.json` (`observedCreated`) and then the public TypeScript `inspectContainer` adapter. Default IPC must contain no `SEEDED_048` values.

Other fixed IPC fixtures are generated by `src-tauri/src/contract_tests.rs`; they are synthetic contract examples, not copied production payloads. Existing direct/ProxyJump application observations are documented in checkpoints 018/030/038/046 and the individual 020–045 evidence. Do not represent fixture tests as native server-operation proof.
